posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
@Fira
the error message you got basically tells you what went wrong and what you (theoretically) would have to do, you're only missing some context to understand it.
The RTP (short for RunTimePackage) is a concept that the RPG-Managers used up to VXAce. It basically means that to prevent everyone from downloading the same pictures and sounds for every game, the base files are packaged differently so they only need to be installed once instead for every single game.
the error message tells you that the game did not find that package, and can't run because it didn't include the graphics it needs in its own download.
Now the OFFICIAL packages are free and available for download in the links on top.
Unfortunately those will not work for games done with pirated versions of the RPG-Maker.
Those old makers were pirated a million times before the official version was released internationally, and in a lot of cases those pirates made their own RTPs and RTP-additions.
From your descriptions it is highly likely that the game you're trying to play was made with a pirated maker, otherwise installing the official RTP would have worked.In that case no one here can help you until the game developer legitimizes his work by buying the official editor and re-release it. (you can't do that because the deployed game is missing the project files).
There is a very small chance that your problems are due to missing rights when trying to install the RTP however - you should try to install the RTP-setup by right-clicking it and then selecting "run as admin" instead of the simple run. If that doesn't help either, then that game was definately done with a pirated maker.

posts.author: sjmorgan86
posts.body:
Maybe I can help. Legacy of Aiden was made with Don Miguels Port of RPG Maker in the early 2000s. I've ran LoA on official rpg maker and streamed a beginning thru end play thru. Try setting it to open like it's being run in Windows 7 for starters.
The rtp mismatch error is a pain, but; the game uses no rtp assets. Lol.
Jamiras is making a VX Ace remake of LoA that's coming along slowly, but is mapped and half evented. Has my blessing and I did a few of the remixed maps.
